limits: One initialization and eight held-out seeds per mode; outcomes do not establish broad playing strength.
Three-round curriculum is not the eleven-round campaign.
Same seeds do not imply identical dice events after policies choose different actions.
Unit removals include combat, surrender and other forced removals.
Current-state and post-training outcome evidence is not a direct per-action causal explanation; full action traces were not retained for these evaluation games.
Observed checkpoint cost cannot be presented as a measured checkpoint-free speedup.
Individual optimizer tensors/replay row contents were not independently deserialized in the final report audit.
The primary tracker excludes Dadao. Final search seed40013 has one Dadao-held zone; its exactzone/IPP and acquisition method are not exposed by these evaluation records.
